question: Which of the following is primarily NOT associated with the folk - dance forms of Punjab?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lavani.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Lavani is a folk dance form that primarily originates from Maharashtra and is not associated with Punjab.**
 
• ** Luddi** is a popular folk dance form of **Punjab that is performed by men and women during weddings and other celebrations.**
 
• **Giddha** is a traditional folk dance form of **Punjab that is primarily performed by women and involves singing and dancing in a circle.**
 
• **Bhangra** is another popular folk dance form of** Punjab that is primarily performed by men and involves energetic and rhythmic movements.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lavani is a folk dance form that is primarily associated with the state of Maharashtra and is performed to the beats of a dholki and a tasha.
 
• Luddi is a popular folk dance form of Punjab that is performed by men and women during weddings and other celebrations and involves a lot of jumping and spinning movements.
 
• Giddha is a traditional folk dance form of Punjab that is primarily performed by women and involves singing and dancing in a circle, with the accompaniment of a dholki and a tumbi.
 
• Bhangra is another popular folk dance form of Punjab that is primarily performed by men and involves energetic and rhythmic movements, with the accompaniment of a dhol and a tumbi.
